name: Honeycomb & Hexagon Generator
description: Fill up to 250 cells across selected sketch regions. End the active tool with Esc and Shift-click regions before opening Honeycomb.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Flat top has horizontal upper and lower edges. Pointy top has a vertex at the top.

across_flats_mm.title: Hexagon size
across_flats_mm.description: Distance between parallel sides of each hexagon.

gap_mm.title: Cell gap
gap_mm.description: Edge-to-edge separation. Use 0.05 mm to four times the hexagon size.

rotation_deg.title: Pattern rotation
rotation_deg.description: Rotates the hexagon grid inside the selected boundary.

trim_cells_at_boundary.title: Trim cells at boundary
trim_cells_at_boundary.description: On keeps trimmed boundary cells. Off keeps only complete hexagons. Both use the same grid anchor and X/Y offsets. Trimmed edges are fixed at the current size and gap.

anchor_mode.title: Pattern anchor
anchor_mode.description: Center and Selected sketch point position a hexagon by its center. Corner anchors align a hexagon to both sides of the fill bounds when the shape allows it. A positive inset uses the inset bounds.

offset_x_mm.title: Grid offset X
offset_x_mm.description: Moves the grid to the right of its anchor in sketch coordinates. Use 0 mm for no X offset.

offset_y_mm.title: Grid offset Y
offset_y_mm.description: Moves the grid up from its anchor in sketch coordinates. Use 0 mm for no Y offset.

outline_inset_mm.title: Inset width
outline_inset_mm.description: Use 0 mm for the original outline. Enter at least 0.01 mm to draw a closed inset outline and fill inside it.
